t: Specialist heavy duty steel-reinforced fixing for dot and dab walls. Steel core bridges cavity between plasterboard and masonry, transferring load directly to blockwork and avoiding plasterboard crushing. Offers 100kg safe working load on 4 fixings. 55kg safe working load / single fixing (safety factor 2). Easy to install using just a drill, screwdriver and hammer. Suitable for all brick and block types, including lightweight blockwork, with 10-30mm maximum fixture depth. 45mm maximum distance to blockwork from face of plasterboard. Ideal for timber battens, shelves and cabinets. Wall plugs, steel cores and screws included.
